title: promptfrenzy.list-ai-tool input
description: Payload for POST https://www.promptfrenzy.com/api/directory/submit — one AI tool to list in the PromptFrenzy AI Directory. Mirrors the live server contract.

url.description: Canonical homepage of the tool, on a durable domain you control. Raw IPs, temporary tunnels and link shorteners are rejected; platform subdomains (*.vercel.app etc.) list as early-stage.

description.description: One-sentence factual description. No superlatives or marketing copy.

badge_url.description: Page on the same domain as url where the PromptFrenzy dofollow badge anchor is present in static HTML. The verifier fetches this page; JS-rendered badges are not seen.

tags.description: Up to 5 lowercase-hyphen tags. Optional but encouraged.

pricing_detail.description: Specific pricing beyond the tier, e.g. 'Free tier watermarked; Pro $12/mo for 1,000 credits'. Optional but encouraged.

key_features.description: 2-6 short factual capability bullets. Optional but encouraged.

works_with.description: Tools, platforms or models this integrates with, e.g. ['chatgpt', 'figma']. Optional but encouraged.

platforms.description: Where the tool runs / how it is accessed. Optional but encouraged.

slug.description: Optional explicit slug; otherwise derived from name. Must be unique in the directory.
